values.description: API root for RideShare — Production (LIVE). LIVE. Real riders, real drivers, real money and real SMS. Every write here reaches a customer. Read-only calls only, unless you have been asked for something specific.
Socket.IO endpoint. Not under /api — it attaches to the server root.
Same environment run locally with docker-compose.prod.yml. Copy this into baseUrl to point at your own machine instead of the deployed host.
